assertions.name: CircuitBreakerTrip
assertions.description: Circuit breaker transitions from CLOSED to OPEN under sustained upstream 503 errors
assertions.observedDetails: Observed CLOSED -> OPEN transition

assertions.name: FastRejection
assertions.description: Open-circuit requests are fast-rejected locally without upstream socket dispatch
assertions.observedDetails: Fast rejection response observed (< 25 ms)

assertions.name: CrossRouteIsolation
assertions.description: Orders outage does not degrade sibling Inventory route availability or open its breaker
assertions.observedDetails: Sibling Inventory service was not running during offline test run

assertions.name: AutomaticRecovery
assertions.description: Circuit breaker transitions OPEN -> HALF_OPEN -> CLOSED automatically when upstream health recovers
assertions.observedDetails: Upstream Orders service was offline; probe recovery could not be observed

assertions.name: TimeoutEnforcement
assertions.description: Gateway timeout enforced and classified as HTTP 504 when upstream latency exceeds deadline
assertions.observedDetails: HTTP 504 timeout enforced cleanly

assertions.name: NoRunawayRetries
assertions.description: Cumulative deadline budget prevents runaway retry loops on slow upstream endpoints
assertions.observedDetails: Retries bounded within cumulative budget

assertions.name: BulkheadPermitRelease
assertions.description: Bulkhead semaphore permits are released in finally block even when request times out
assertions.observedDetails: All permits accounted for after timeout

assertions.name: CrossRouteLatencyIsolation
assertions.description: Slow calls to Orders route do not inflate latency or consume permits of Inventory route
assertions.observedDetails: Sibling Inventory service was not running during offline test run

assertions.name: ConcurrencyLimitEnforced
assertions.description: Route bulkhead strictly limits concurrent executions to configured permit ceiling
assertions.observedDetails: Peak concurrency did not exceed limit (10 permits)

assertions.name: ExcessFastRejection
assertions.description: Excess concurrent requests beyond permit capacity receive immediate BULKHEAD_REJECTED
assertions.observedDetails: Recorded 5 BULKHEAD_REJECTED responses

assertions.name: PermitRecovery
assertions.description: All semaphore permits are returned to available capacity after requests complete
assertions.observedDetails: Permits fully recovered with zero leaks

assertions.name: SiblingRouteBulkheadIsolation
assertions.description: Bulkhead saturation on Orders route does not consume permits or block Inventory traffic
assertions.observedDetails: Sibling Inventory service was not running during offline test run

assertions.name: RedisFailClosed
assertions.description: Rate limiter fails closed (HTTP 503) when Redis dependency is unavailable
assertions.observedDetails: Request was blocked with HTTP 503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE

assertions.name: UpstreamIsolationOnDependencyFailure
assertions.description: Unverified quota requests are never dispatched upstream when rate limiter is down
assertions.observedDetails: Zero upstream calls dispatched during failure

assertions.name: LimiterRecovery
assertions.description: Rate limiter resumes normal token evaluation immediately upon connectivity restoration
assertions.observedDetails: Normal quota consumption verified

assertions.name: PolicyDenyEnforcement
assertions.description: Active DENY policy blocks unauthorized requests with HTTP 403
assertions.observedDetails: HTTP 403 received

assertions.name: ZeroQuotaLeakOnPolicyDenial
assertions.description: Policy denial terminates request before token-bucket deduction
assertions.observedDetails: Zero tokens deducted

assertions.name: ZeroUpstreamDispatchOnDeny
assertions.description: Policy denial short-circuits locally with zero upstream calls
assertions.observedDetails: Zero upstream dispatches

assertions.name: TransactionalPolicyRollback
assertions.description: Transactional rollback reinstates previous validated active policy version
assertions.observedDetails: Restored baseline version

assertions.name: PolicyAuditCompleteness
assertions.description: Every activation and rollback records an immutable audit trail entry
assertions.observedDetails: Complete audit history captured

assertions.name: BoundedIdempotentRetries
assertions.description: Idempotent GET requests are retried upon transient failures up to maxAttempts budget
assertions.observedDetails: GET retried 2 times and completed with HTTP 200

assertions.name: NonIdempotentMethodSafety
assertions.description: Non-idempotent POST requests are never automatically retried to prevent duplicate mutations
assertions.observedDetails: POST failed with HTTP 503 after exactly 1 attempt (zero retries)

assertions.name: SingleQuotaDeductionPerRequest
assertions.description: Consumer quota is consumed strictly once per logical request, regardless of retry count
assertions.observedDetails: Single token consumed for multi-attempt request

assertions.name: RetryAmplificationTracking
assertions.description: Gateway tracks logical requests vs upstream attempts to quantify retry amplification ratio
assertions.observedDetails: Retry amplification ratio measured at 2.00x
